notes: These candidate mappings identify the canonical IEEE 1516.1-2025 ownership-service clauses exercised by the portable C++ scenario. The test source is limited to the official C++ API and standard library; its adapter supplies provider, FOM, endpoint, and callback configuration. The mappings make no conformance claim and exclude cancellation, partial transfers, DDM, save/restore, and provider-specific behavior.

requirements.statement: The owner requests negotiated attribute divestiture for the adapter-supplied object and attribute; the test verifies that ownership remains with the owner until Confirm Divestiture.
The owner receives a confirmation request identifying the object and attribute set, with the pending regular acquisition request's user tag.
After the request callback, the owner confirms divestiture; the test verifies transfer occurs only after confirmation and queries the resulting ownership state at both federates.
The prospective owner requests the attribute through ordinary Attribute Ownership Acquisition and supplies the tag later checked on the owner's confirmation-request callback.
The acquirer receives the confirmed object and attribute set with the divesting owner's Confirm Divestiture tag, and the test verifies the resulting ownership transfer.
